title: Comparisons in charts and tables
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply comparisons in charts and tables in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 比较自编表格：虚构 A/B/C 校区自行车使用率分别为 40/25/35%，公交为 30/50/20%。其余方式未列出。
grammar: 比较须保持对象与指标一致。whereas 连接对照；twice as high as 表示倍数，不是 two times higher 的含糊表达。不同类别比例之和不必等于 100，除非题面说明覆盖所有类别。
common_mistake: 不能把两种交通方式的部分表格当成完整出行分布。

examples.text: Bus use was highest at campus B in the invented table.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: Half of its commuters used buses, compared with a quarter who cycled.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: Campus A showed the opposite ordering, with cycling at 40% and buses at 30%.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: At campus C, the gap was fifteen percentage points in favour of cycling.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

reading: Bus use was highest at campus B in the invented table. Half of its commuters used buses, compared with a quarter who cycled. Campus A showed the opposite ordering, with cycling at 40% and buses at 30%. At campus C, the gap was fifteen percentage points in favour of cycling. These figures cover only two transport categories. A report can compare the listed modes but cannot identify the missing categories without further information. The overview should emphasise the contrast between B and the other campuses.

questions.prompt: At B, how does bus use compare with cycling ?
questions.answer: It is twice as high: 50% versus 25%.
questions.explanation: 倍数基于相同指标，两者差 25 个百分点。

questions.prompt: What is the gap at C ?
questions.explanation: 35%−20%=15 个百分点，不是简单写增加 15%。

pronunciation: sentence stress; connected speech; intelligibility without a total score。先按意群朗读，再用选词面板练习；浏览器转写不能证明音素正确。
production: Produce an original spoken explanation plus a written reflection demonstrating comparisons in charts and tables
self_review: 核对任务是否回答完整、信息是否有原文证据、目标结构是否准确。记录一次修改及理由；开放题允许不同的有据答案，不计算官方等级分数。
